- [FACT] User is interested in seafood dishes commonly found in Jaffna and its surrounding areas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jaffna Crab Curry is a spicy curry made with fresh crab meat cooked in a blend of aromatic spices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fish Puttu is a savory dish made with grated fish mixed with grated coconut and steamed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prawn Masala consists of prawns cooked in a spicy tomato-based sauce with onions and garlic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cuttlefish Fry is made by marinating cuttlefish in a blend of spices and frying until crispy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fish Curry is a popular dish made with fresh fish fillets cooked in a thick curry sauce.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fish Kool is a traditional Jaffna fish stew made with a variety of seafood, including fish, prawns, and mussels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Squid Curry is squid cooked in a spicy curry sauce with onions, tomatoes, and coconut milk.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fish Pittu is a steamed dish made with grated fish, coconut, and red rice flour.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fish Vadai consists of deep-fried balls made with ground fish, onions, and spices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Spicy Prawn Fry involves marinating prawns in a blend of spices and frying until crispy.
